| Test name | Reason (brief) |
|-----------|----------------|
| `test_stuck_inbox` | Simulated inbox lock timed out – indicates a regression in the new inbox‑handler logic. |
| `test_run_now` | The “Run Now” endpoint returned HTTP 202 instead of 200 after a recent refactor. |
| `test_cost_predictor` | Cost guard aborted the prediction job because the estimated cost exceeded the hard‑limit configuration. |
| `test_memory_inspector` | Memory‑profile JSON schema mismatch (new `usage_bytes` field not recognized). |
| `test_promotion_queue` | Queue‑promotion API returned an empty list – the mock data file `tests/fixtures/promo_queue.json` was missing a required entry. |

All other 133 tests passed, confirming that the core AAFL pipeline (including the watchdog, cost‑guard, and server interaction) is functional.
